legacyMilestones.title: Goals defined
legacyMilestones.description: Agree on the founder’s priority goals and success measures.

legacyMilestones.title: Sessions scheduled
legacyMilestones.description: Book the agreed guidance session or recurring check-ins together.

legacyMilestones.title: Guidance delivered
legacyMilestones.description: Share the agreed guidance and key takeaways.

legacyMilestones.title: Follow-up actions logged
legacyMilestones.description: Capture the agreed next steps and owners.

legacyMilestones.title: Progress reflected on together
legacyMilestones.description: Discuss progress and what comes next. This shared reflection is separate from the private review after completion.

fields.label: Audience sizes
fields.help: Swaps more than 10 times uneven are flagged in matching. Record any agreed adjustment here.

milestones.title: Assets shared
milestones.description: Share the copy, images and links each side will promote.

milestones.title: Draft approved
milestones.description: Each side approves how it will be presented to the other’s audience.

milestones.title: Send date locked
milestones.description: Confirm the agreed send dates for both audiences.

milestones.title: Swap executed
milestones.description: Both promotions go out as agreed.

milestones.title: Results reported
milestones.description: Share reach, clicks and sign-ups from each send.

termPlaceholders.goal: For example: Introduce each other to our newsletter readers
termPlaceholders.scope: For example: Each side writes one feature about the other and sends it once.
termPlaceholders.timeline: For example: Both sends in the week of 8 December
termPlaceholders.commitment: For example: One feature and one send each
termPlaceholders.compensation: For example: One newsletter feature each way

milestones.title: Scope defined
milestones.description: Confirm what will be tested and what success looks like.

milestones.title: Testers assigned
milestones.description: Invite the agreed number of testers.

milestones.title: Feedback submitted
milestones.description: Collect feedback using the agreed method.

milestones.title: Issues reviewed
milestones.description: Review findings and agree on next steps.

termPlaceholders.goal: For example: Get 20 students to test our onboarding
termPlaceholders.scope: For example: We share a test build and a feedback form; you recruit testers and send a summary.
termPlaceholders.timeline: For example: Two weeks from 1 December
termPlaceholders.commitment: For example: About 2 hours a week each
termPlaceholders.compensation: For example: Testers for our app in return for testers for yours

fields.label: How you will share
fields.placeholder: For example: calls, a shared doc or async comments

milestones.title: Trade agreed
milestones.description: Confirm what each side shares and what a useful result looks like.

milestones.title: First side shared
milestones.description: One side delivers their part: a review, playbook, introduction or working session.

milestones.title: Second side shared
milestones.description: The other side delivers their part.

milestones.title: Advice applied
milestones.description: Each side notes what they will change as a result.

milestones.title: Wrap-up
milestones.description: Agree whether to continue or close the swap.

termPlaceholders.goal: For example: Set launch pricing using each other’s experience
termPlaceholders.scope: For example: You review our pricing page; we review your onboarding and write up notes.
termPlaceholders.commitment: For example: Two calls of 45 minutes each
termPlaceholders.compensation: For example: Pricing advice in return for product feedback
